title: Stabilization of ERK-Phosphorylated METTL3 by USP5 Increases m6A Methylation
model: HeLa, genome-wide GeCKO KO, circular-RNA m6A-GFP reporter
contrast: Low-GFP vs high-GFP (1 vs 1; no-replicate path)
paper_method: Ranked gene lists per bin + RAS/MAPK pathway GSEA
paper_calls: ERK/MAPK pathway and USP5 (validated biochemically; no gene-level FDR hits)
verdict: With one library per bin the screen is uninformative at the gene level: BARCS calls no hits and the named genes rank randomly, consistent with the paper drawing its conclusions from pathway GSEA and biochemistry rather than gene-level screen significance.
